title: Strict scalar/pullback square on quotient towers
statement: For the scalar extension and pullback strict quotient functors attached to a morphism f:X→Y, the normalized left and right chain isomorphisms agree on the whole quotient tower.

source.place: Tags 03EL and 07A4, homogeneous generator calculation in the strict quotient systems.

proof.text: Use natural-isomorphism, natural-transformation and chain-map extensionality. Transpose first through scalar extension/restriction and then through pullback/direct image. The sheaf tensor pairing and the coproduct inclusions of the signed total detect equality, reducing each degree to homogeneous generators on the original sequence site.

On a homogeneous generator, the scalar/pullback associator sends the scalar unit of a pullback section to the pullback of its scalar unit. Pullback naturality, the sigma normalization at coefficient one and the pullback/tensor normalization compute the left route as the tensor of the pullbacks of the two scalar unit sections. For the right route use scalar naturality, the pullback/tensor normalization, sigma at coefficient one, and naturality of the tensor generators. Applying the same scalar/pullback formula to both factors gives exactly the left-route tensor. All maps are already maps on the sequence site, so this equality retains every quotient transition.

proof_origin.place: Tags 03EL and 07A4; R4 formalizes the homogeneous-generator argument using the existing strict sequence-site normalizations and their proved adjunction and tensor-generator helpers.

from.place: strict part of the original proof step

lean.statement:
theorem scalarTowerPullbackStrictSquare {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    leftRoute l E L ι f = rightRoute l E L ι f
